profile.name: Toni Guillem
profile.title: Technical Game Designer
profile.intro: I design combat mechanics, gameplay abilities and levels.
profile.bio: I started as a gameplay programmer. At Ubisoft I worked on Operator reworks for Rainbow Six Siege, and at Novarama I led the design of the weapon systems for United 1944.

projects.title: Rainbow Six Siege
projects.imageAlt: The Rainbow Six Siege operator roster
projects.label: Operator design / Systems / Balance
projects.summary: Reworked Lion and Tachanka and designed gadgets for Defenders.
projects.intro: I worked on Operator balance and gadget design with teams in Barcelona and Montréal.

sections.title: Tachanka’s grenade launcher
sections.body: I designed and prototyped an incendiary grenade launcher to give Tachanka an area-denial role away from his stationary turret. I tested the radius and duration of the fire zones. We converted his turret LMG into a primary weapon. Ubisoft approved the design and prototype before I left, and the rework shipped in 2020.
sections.imageAlt: Tachanka in a steel helmet with a weapon resting on his shoulder.

sections.title: Lion’s detection pings
sections.body: Lion’s scan originally revealed enemy silhouettes. We replaced the outlines with location pings so opponents could move after detection without giving away their full path. Lion returned to Pro League in June 2019.

sections.title: Proximity Alarm
sections.body: The Proximity Alarm gives Defenders an audio cue when an attacker comes within range. Players can throw it onto a surface near another gadget. Attackers can disable it with an EMP or destroy it with gunfire, explosives or melee. It shipped after I left Ubisoft.

sections.title: Bulletproof Camera
sections.body: I designed the camera with artists, animators and sound designers in Montréal. Defenders can mount it on floors or walls and see through smoke. Its front plate resists gunfire, but attackers can shoot the weak spot or use explosives or melee.

sections.title: Ela and Zofia’s concussion effect
sections.body: I designed the concussion effect first used by Ela’s mines and Zofia’s grenades. I worked with a gameplay programmer and a VFX artist on how the blast disrupted movement, shooting and hearing.
sections.imageAlt: Ela and Zofia walking side by side through smoke.

sections.title: Balance testing and other systems
sections.body: I worked with Data Analytics and User Research to evaluate balance changes, gathered feedback through professional-player workshops, and iterated through the Test Server. Earlier contributions included Tactical Realism’s magazine management, team loadout information, weapon previews, and map concept proposals.

projects.title: United 1944
projects.imageAlt: United 1944 soldiers against orange battlefield artwork
projects.label: Shooter feel / Weapons / Design leadership
projects.summary: Designed recoil, spread and reloading for more than 20 WWII weapons.
projects.intro: I led core gameplay design for a 16v16 multiplayer shooter built in Unreal Engine 5. Players craft weapons, build defenses and fight over territory.

sections.title: Weapon handling
sections.body: I designed recoil, spread and reload mechanics for more than 20 WWII weapons across over eight weapon families.

sections.title: Gadgets and passive abilities
sections.body: I designed explosives, intelligence-gathering gadgets and passive abilities to complement the gunplay.

sections.title: Design team
sections.body: I reviewed prototypes with programmers, animators and sound designers, planned features with production and mentored a small team of designers.

projects.title: Assassin’s Creed Chronicles
projects.label: Level design / Quest design / UE3
projects.summary: Designed Challenge Room missions and built their levels in Unreal Engine 3.
projects.intro: At Ubisoft, I worked with Climax Studios on short, replayable missions set in the Animus.

sections.title: Challenge Room missions
sections.body: We built three types of Challenge Room: Collect, Contract and Assassination. I combined navigation, stealth and combat mechanics from the campaign into missions players could finish in a short session and replay.

sections.title: Level layouts
sections.body: I took levels from initial layout into Unreal Engine 3. The Animus’s abstract environment let us explore 2.5D navigation more freely than the main campaign’s realistic settings.

projects.title: Madden NFL 21 & PGA Tour
projects.label: Presentation / Progression / Team building
projects.summary: Led design on the Stadia version of Madden NFL 21 and worked on player progression for PGA Tour.
projects.intro: I joined EA Tiburon’s new Madrid division in January 2020 as its first game designer.

sections.title: Madden NFL 21 and PGA Tour
sections.body: I worked with the franchise leads in Orlando on Madden NFL 21 for Stadia, then designed presentation and player-progression features for PGA Tour. I also helped the studio director recruit two designers in Madrid.

projects.title: Hazel Dazzle
projects.imageAlt: Spherical planetary gameplay from Hazel Dazzle
projects.label: Gameplay programming / 3D puzzles
projects.summary: Programmed combat, planetary navigation and motion-controlled puzzles for iPad.
projects.intro: I spent two years as the main game programmer on this iPad adventure.

sections.title: Planetary navigation and dungeon combat
sections.body: I engineered gameplay that moved between spherical 3D planetary navigation and isometric 2D dungeon exploration. My work included combo-based combat, character abilities, and an AI companion.

sections.title: Motion-controlled puzzles
sections.body: I designed a 3D puzzle system using the iPad’s accelerometer and gyroscope. Forced perspective helped make the screen feel like a physical box that players could manipulate in their hands.

projects.title: Burning Thirst
projects.label: Combat / Cinematics / Audio
projects.summary: Designed combat combos and special attacks, scripted cinematics and created the audio.
projects.intro: Five of us made this hack-and-slash game for our master’s degree. The team included three programmers and two artists.

sections.title: Combat, cinematics and audio
sections.body: I designed combat combos, fatalities, and special attacks, drawing on God of War 3 as a reference. I also designed, scripted, and implemented our cinematic system alongside an artist, with a narrative influenced by Grindhouse and Planet Terror, and took care of the game’s audio design.

studioWork.label: Latest role
studioWork.summary: Worked with the Gameplay Ability System (GAS) in Unreal Engine 5.
Designed gameplay abilities, wrote their technical specifications and implemented them in Unreal Engine 5.
